bios.title: Akụkọ ndụ
bios.text: Enwere ike ihota ma ọ bụ megharịa ụdị ndị a maka akụkọ ndị nta akụkọ.
bios.fullFirst: Denzel Rigaud guzobere EXPECTEDEND LLC ma wuo MyBibleLens na The Water Check n'onwe ya. Ọ na-arụ ọrụ dị ka onye mmepụta full-stack nke ụlọ ọrụ ahụ, na-akpụzi ngwaahịa ọ bụla site n'echiche ruo n'imewe, injinịa, na mwepụta.
bios.fullSecond: Ọrụ ya gbadoro ụkwụ na software gbadoro ụkwụ n'okwukwe, ọdịmma n'ụwa dijitalụ, na ngwaọrụ bara uru na-enyere ndị mmadụ aka iji teknụzụ n'ebumnuche. MyBibleLens bụ ngwa ebe nsọ maka Ndị Kraịst. The Water Check jikọtara ntụle mmiri nzuzo, omume mmiri bara uru, na obodo lekwasịrị anya n'ịnọgide na-eme ya kwa ụbọchị.

facts.title: Eziokwu e nyochara
facts.text: Nkọwa ziri ezi maka profaịlụ, edemede, nkọwa foto, na ebe nchekwa data.

projects.title: Ọrụ ahụ
projects.text: Ngwaahịa abụọ, e wuru n'onwe n'okpuru Expected End.
